dogecoin.text: By the following morning Dogecoin hit a swing low of $0.401, a cumulative drop of 43.6% and lost value of $35 Billion.

It’s mental that doge lost some currency, it was probably because of expectations of a surge in interest in Dogecoin resulting from Elon Musk's appearance on Saturday Night Live, Dogecoin dropped 34% from $.711 at the opening of the show to below $.470 45 minutes later.
